checks.lead: Abu'l Hassan Ali ibn Ridwan Al-Misri (Arabic: أبو الحسن علي بن رضوان بن علي بن جعفر المصري) (c. 988 - c. 1061) was an Arab who lived in Egypt and was a physician, astrologer and astronomer, born in Giza.
